I had an incredible experience at Phuket Dental Plus Clinic. When I urgently needed dental care on a Sunday, they went above and beyond to accommodate me. The dentist was exceptionally kind, professional, and gentle throughout the entire procedure.

What impressed me most was their willingness to see me on short notice during the weekend. Despite it being an emergency appointment on a Sunday, the cost was surprisingly affordable. The dentist's expertise was evident in their delicate touch and thorough approach.

The clinic's commitment to patient care is truly commendable. They not only addressed my dental emergency promptly but also ensured I felt comfortable and well-cared for throughout my visit. I highly recommend Phuket Dental Plus Clinic for anyone seeking top-notch dental care with a personal touch, especially in urgent situations.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​

I've been through a lot of dentists in my time, on three different continents. These guys were amazing.

I came in needing fillings and a root canal on my rear tooth. Another dentist in Bangkok said the tooth was too curved and recommended removing the tooth instead.

Then I went down to Phuket and found this place based on the reviews, I was not disappointed. The dentist filled the cavities, then referred me to their travelling root canal specialist.

The specialist was an absolute angel. Very flexible in trying to book my appointments, gentle and precise in her work, and she even moved appointments around to fit me in for the final session before I had to fly home the next day. Prices were reasonable and I would definitely recommend going there for all your dental needs.
